Introduce two generic, bot/topic-scoped tables — `commitments` and `events` — with Hector-only tool exposure in v1. Compute and render an adherence checklist in `hot_context_solo` for Hector. Add persona + prompt module, registry gate, tool allowlist, and focused tests/evals for commitments, events, adherence state computation, hot-context rendering, scope, allowlist, and prompt behavior. Preserve existing user changes (`.env.example`, `app/config.py`, `app/services/agentic.py`, `tests/test_config.py`, `tests/test_llm_phase.py`, `app/services/deepseek.py`) and avoid unrelated refactors.

**Scope:** Small
